key_entities: pytest -m 'integration and not live and not jira_live'
propositions: Default gating test suite runs serially with branch coverage and takes ~22 min, dominated by pytest execution time; pytest-xdist parallelization achieves ~5× speedup (1700s to ~350s) with identical test outcomes.

pytest-xdist coverage collection without parallel=true in tool.coverage.run deflates the combined TOTAL coverage report (e.g., ~37% vs true 80%), causing fail_under threshold violations and leaving .coverage.* files in the checkout.

Live integration tests (marked with [integration, live]) share a single Jira project and flake under parallel load due to eventual-consistency; they must remain serial or be confined to a single worker via xdist_group.

pytest-xdist and pytest-split must be added to [dev] in pyproject.toml pinned exactly, and runner vCPU count must be explicitly pinned (-n4 for ubuntu-latest, -n3 for macos arm) rather than auto-detected to avoid over-subscription.

Documentation in docs/coverage.md must be updated to record that coverage collection under pytest-xdist requires parallel=true in tool.coverage.run; otherwise the combined TOTAL is silently deflated and trips fail_under thresholds.
